title: Nacional-AM Seeks Historic Promotion Against CSA
seoTitle: Nacional-AM seeks historic promotion against CSA
subtitle: Playoff classic puts 'Leão' one step away from 2027 Série C promotion
excerpt: Leading 3-1 from the first leg, Nacional-AM holds an advantage against CSA at Estádio Rei Pelé. The aggregate score will decide Série C promotion, a historic milestone.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Nacional-AM enters the decisive match against CSA with a 3-1 advantage from the first leg, played at Arena da Amazônia. The clash, scheduled for this Thursday (3) at 8 PM, will determine who secures a spot in the 2027 Série C.

What's at Stake at Estádio Rei Pelé

The match will take place at Estádio Rei Pelé, in Maceió, and serves as a playoff round created under the new Série D format, which now grants six promotions. If the aggregate score remains favorable to Nacional, the club secures promotion even if they lose by one goal.

How the First-Leg Advantage Was Built

In the first match, 'Leão' won 3-1, with forward Sassá being a standout and the winning lineup maintained. Coach Thiago Gomes intends to keep the same team on the field, with Renanzinho and Ryan Santos, who traveled normally, expected to feature.

Predicted Lineups for the Second Leg

CSA is expected to change its starting lineup, putting Wellerson in goal instead of Yago Oliveira and seeking a comeback with Dudu Figueiredo in midfield. In defense, Amorim returns from injury. CSA's probable formation is: Wellerson; Caio Hila, Amorim, Rafael Castro, and Ailton Santos; Camacho, Kayllan, Fabrício Bigode, and Dudu Figueiredo; Matheus Melo and Rian Santana.

Nacional-AM's probable team is: Igor Rayan; Ryan Santos, Fredson, Michel, and Mateus Müller; Wendel, Erick Varão, and Rifle; Renanzinho, Rafa Marcos, and Sassá.

Recent History and the Importance of Promotion

Nacional, the biggest representative of Amazonas in Série D, is competing in the tournament for the ninth time and has never come so close to promotion. Should they confirm qualification, they will be the first centennial club from the state to achieve national promotion since the implementation of the division system.

Broadcast and Fan Expectations

The match will be broadcast live and free online on the Metrópoles YouTube channel. The advantage built in the first leg puts Nacional in a privileged position, but CSA needs to win by two or more goals to overturn the aggregate score.

With information from ge, Terra.
